about: Rules that a guide or exposure page marks twice or more in one block (rule-marks.test.ts). Each is listed with why it is left; a new one fails, and so does one that is gone or changed, until its entry is removed. `blocks` is how many blocks of the page mark the rule twice.

leftovers.why: The paragraph comparing makam with a deposit opens BANK-18 for both the custody ban and the buy, sell and redemption fees, with BRK-17 between them. Which of BANK-18 and BRK-17 owns the custody ban on makam is not settled; the two marks are folded once it is.
